answer: It returns a deterministic 32-hex md5 of source:position:content[:100]; a 16-hex prefix is neither an integer nor a UUID so Qdrant rejects the upsert. See src/devmate/ingest/chunker.py [1].
cost_tracker.record_usage(provider, model, usage, latency_ms) accumulates per-model requests, tokens, and cost; get_summary aggregates over a time window. See src/devmate/obs/cost.py [1].
When stream=true the /ask endpoint returns SSE text/event-stream chunks with anti-buffering headers, X-Conversation-ID, and a final data: [DONE] sentinel. See src/devmate/api/main.py [1].
The compose server is qdrant 1.8.0 and client >=1.13 removed the .search() API that vector_store.py relies on; both sides must move together. See pyproject.toml [1].
Consecutive chunks share overlap characters so a sentence split across a chunk boundary is still retrievable in full from at least one chunk. See src/devmate/ingest/chunker.py [1].
The client walks its fallback chain: the configured default provider first, then every other registered provider, and raises LLMError only when all fail. See src/devmate/llm/client.py [1].
PromptInjectionGuardrail analyzes input for injection signatures and can sanitize or block suspicious prompts before they reach the LLM. See src/devmate/guards/guardrails.py [1].

When use_reranker is true, retrieved candidates are reranked and the top rerank_top_k are kept, trading latency for better precision at the top of the context. See src/devmate/retrieve/retriever.py [1].
metadata is reserved by SQLAlchemy's Declarative API; the attribute is named meta while the column keeps the name metadata via mapped_column(name=...). See src/devmate/db/models.py [1].
Three tools: search_code, read_file, and get_repo_stats, served over stdio and SSE transports. See src/devmate/mcp/server.py [1].
